## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it belongs in `convMMD`.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. For scientific-method changes,
include the relevant scientific sanity check.

## Compatibility and scientific behavior

Describe any change to the public API, numerical behavior, observation-model
assumptions, reproducibility, checkpoints, dependencies, or supported Python
versions. Write `None` if there is no change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change within the documented research-preview scope.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests and documentation where needed.
- [ ] I used simulation truth only for evaluation, never for fitting.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, checkpoints, caches, logs, or large experiment outputs.
- [ ] I agree that this contribution may be distributed under the MIT License.
